prompt: Custom builtins handling needs a cleanup. Names passed via `builtins=` to the checker and names from the PYFLAKES_BUILTINS environment variable (comma separated) must both be treated as defined. Please compute the environment-provided set once in a cached module-level helper in the checker module named `_custom_builtins()` (a functools-cached function returning a frozenset; tests call `_custom_builtins.cache_clear()`), and fold the magic globals (__file__, __builtins__, __annotations__, WindowsError) into the module's set of builtin names.
